translations.web: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
translations.bsb: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.
translations.kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
